auditMethod: indexed English Wowhead source excerpts plus local repository code review; no browser-rendered translation verification

finding.description: Guide slugs such as bis-gear, tier-set-bonuses, raid and prepatch omit role. Previously their browserCase.role could be falsified while class/spec and section still matched URL, creating false tank/healer/DPS coverage.
finding.fix: Validate every browserCase class/spec against a compact, data-only retail specialization role table; unknown specs fail closed.
finding.scope: offline audit gate only; no browser extension or runtime translation changes

sourceObservations: Devourer tier-set guide describes Midnight Season 1 bonuses while linking Season 2 gear and has mixed season wording; source editorial issue, not a translation override.
Restoration Druid prepatch uses WoW healing terminology including HoTs, ramp, Swiftmend, Wild Growth and Lifebloom.
Protection Paladin prepatch uses generator/spender, Holy Power and defensive cooldown terminology.

translationVerification.currentGlossaryCheck: MEZU player glossary has ramp and tier set bonus shorthand; manual overrides include Holy Power. Official spell-name resolution must be checked by canonical IDs, not guessed from indexed prose.
translationVerification.datapackDirectInspection: Large generated datapack could not be read through connector (empty content); no claim of complete output simulation.

limitations: Wowhead full HTML may present a JavaScript challenge; indexed excerpts are not complete DOM evidence.
No local Chrome Translator API execution; strict browser evidence is outstanding.
Do not count source-only samples as clean audit cycles.
